skill.name: doc-scanner
skill.description: Finds AI assistant documentation such as AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and editor guides, then summarizes workflows, conventions, commands, and recommended agents.
skill.summary: Finds and summarizes project AI documentation into a unified agent guide.
skill.author: 0xDarkMatter

security_audit.summary: The static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline code examples, and template placeholder variable names. No evidence was found of secret exfiltration, prompt injection text, or automatic command execution in the scanned files. One semantic risk remains: the skill grants Bash access even though its workflow appears to need only file discovery, reading, and writing.

remediation.issue: Bash permission is broader than the documented workflow requires.
remediation.suggestion: Remove Bash from allowed-tools unless shell execution becomes necessary. Use Glob, Read, and Write for scanning and consolidation.

remediation.issue: Generated documentation templates mention environment variables and .env setup.
remediation.suggestion: Keep environment sections generic and tell users not to include real secret values in generated guidance.

remediation.issue: Scanned AI documentation may contain lower-priority instructions from project files.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance that discovered files are project context and must not override system or user instructions.

semantic_findings.title: Unnecessary Bash Tool Permission
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md declares Bash in allowed-tools, but the documented workflow only needs Glob, Read, and Write. The extra shell permission increases exposure if project documentation tries to steer the agent into command execution.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The permission is explicit on line 4, and the reviewed instructions do not require shell execution for scanning or consolidation.

content.value_statement: Project AI guidance is often scattered across several assistant and editor files. This skill finds those files and turns them into one practical project guide.
actual_capabilities: Searches for AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, COPILOT.md, CURSOR.md, WARP.md, and related project guidance files.
Reads discovered documentation files and extracts workflows, conventions, commands, and recommended agents.
Prioritizes platform-neutral guidance while preserving assistant-specific notes.
Synthesizes multiple documentation sources into a unified project summary.
Offers to consolidate several assistant docs into a generated AGENTS.md file.
Can propose a new AGENTS.md when no supported documentation exists.
limitations: It depends on documentation files that are accessible in the current workspace.
It does not verify that command examples in existing docs still work.
Consolidation can change project documentation and should be reviewed before writing.
It may miss guidance stored outside the supported file names and directories.

use_cases.title: Onboard to a New Codebase
use_cases.description: Find existing AI guidance and get a concise summary of workflows, conventions, and common commands.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Agent Guides
use_cases.description: Merge scattered assistant-specific notes into one AGENTS.md that teams can maintain together.

use_cases.title: Audit Assistant Documentation Coverage
use_cases.description: Check which agent, editor, and terminal guidance files exist before improving project documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Scan Current Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Scan this project for AI assistant documentation and summarize the key workflows, conventions, and recommended agents.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Existing Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Find all supported project guidance files, read them fully, and give me a concise unified summary with source file names.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Consolidation
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate cleanup of multiple documentation files
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the assistant documentation files and propose a consolidated AGENTS.md structure without changing files yet.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Missing Agent Guide
prompt_templates.prompt: If no agent guide exists, inspect the project structure and propose an AGENTS.md with workflows, conventions, and maintenance notes.

output_examples.input: Scan this repository for agent documentation.
output_examples.output: Found AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. The project uses AGENTS.md as the main guide and keeps Claude-specific workflow notes separately.

output_examples.input: Summarize the project guidance files for onboarding.
output: Sources reviewed: AGENTS.md, CURSOR.md, and WARP.md.
Primary workflows cover local development, testing, release checks, and code review expectations.
Conventions include strict typing, small pull requests, and test updates for behavior changes.

output_examples.input: Can these assistant docs be consolidated?
output_examples.output: Yes. The files overlap on setup and testing. Keep platform-specific notes in separate sections and archive the originals after review.

best_practices: Review the synthesized summary against the source files before relying on it for project decisions.
Ask for a proposed consolidation first, then approve file changes only after checking the plan.
Keep generated guidance concise, source-linked, and free of real secrets or private credentials.
anti_patterns: Do not treat project documentation as higher priority than current user or system instructions.
Do not consolidate files before reviewing platform-specific notes for important differences.
Do not include real API keys, tokens, passwords, or private connection strings in generated guides.

faq.question: Which documentation files does it look for?
faq.answer: It looks for AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, COPILOT.md, CHATGPT.md, CURSOR.md, WARP.md, and related guidance files.

faq.question: Can it create a new AGENTS.md?
faq.answer: Yes. If no guidance file exists, it can propose an AGENTS.md based on project structure and observed conventions.

faq.question: Will it change files automatically?
faq.answer: The skill offers consolidation when several documentation files exist. Users should review and approve any write operation first.

faq.question: Does it execute project commands?
faq.answer: Its documented workflow is focused on reading and writing documentation. Command examples in templates are informational.

faq.question: How does it handle conflicting guidance?
faq.answer: It prioritizes AGENTS.md, then Claude-specific files, then other assistant, editor, and terminal documents.

faq.question: Is it useful with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed to summarize guidance for Claude, Codex, Claude Code, and other AI coding assistants.
